{{Quote|It looks as if the PLB has decided to start the revolution!|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Rial Pernon]]|<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess]]''</ref>}}
The '''Eiattu Campaign''' occurred when the forces of the [[People's Liberation Battalion]] attacked the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] citadel on [[Eiattu 6]]. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] helped defeat the Imperial forces, and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Isplourrdacartha Estillo]] exposed the supposed Prince [[Harrandatha Estillo]], leading the PLB, as an [[Harrandatha Estillo (impostor)|impostor]] working for [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Leonia Tavira]].

==Background==
{{Quote|My world is a troubled one. It has always been thus.|[[Grand Duke]] [[Gror Pernon]]|<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess" />}}
Several years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Eiattu 6]] society was shaked up by the arrival of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on its world. The planet's nobles, known as the [[Priamsta]], eventually murdered the royal family and took power on the world. The Priamsta acted as an oligarchy but found itself embroiled in a [[Eiattu Civil War|civil war]] against the [[People's Liberation Battalion]] led by a heir to the royal line: [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Harrandatha Estillo (impostor)|Harrandatha Estillo]].

[[File:PLB_fighting.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[People's Liberation Battalion|PLB]] fighting [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in the swamps of Eiattu.]]

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Priamsta discovered that another heiress had survived, Princess [[Isplourrdacartha Estillo]], also known as [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] Plourr Ilo. The Rogues got a visit from [[Grand Duke]] [[Gror Pernon]] and were ordered to escort Plourr and Pernon to Eiattu.

==The battle==
{{Quote|I feel the Empire is not long for this system. I intend to get what I can, while I can. If Harran succeeds, I can leave this backward planet to the PLB. I have raided enough credits to do anything, go anywhere. Or, I can marry Harran, kill him, and rule poor Eiattu as his widow. Either way, I'll have what I want.|[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Leonia Tavira]]|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 16">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 16|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 16]]</ref>}}
[[File:Tavira_escapes.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Leonia Tavira]] escapes.]]

After their arrival on Eiattu 6, the Rogues set out in the planet's swamps to find Prince Harran. They were ambushed by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and saved by the People's Liberation Battalion and other Rogues in [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]]. In the capital, Plourr chose to side with Harran and officially announced her desire to remove the hypocritical noble class from power. Plourr and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Rial Pernon]] were attacked by forces bearing ties to the Priamsta and Count [[Arian Laabann]]. In the swamps, several Rogues ([[Ibtisam]], [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]], [[Feylis Ardele]], [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], [[Dllr Nep]], and [[Herian I'ngre]]) were captured by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Leonia Tavira]]. Plourr finally revealed to Count Pernon and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] that Harran cannot possibly be the true Harrandatha, because she killed Harran herself when she was a child after he had been corrupted by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Moff Tavira then revealed to the captive Rogues that the current Harran Estillo was really an imposter meant to take the real Harran's place in the royal family as a spy for the Empire.

[[File:PeoplesLiberationBattalion-XWingRogueSquadron16.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The PLB in the burning [[Imperial Citadel (Eiattu 6)|Imperial Citadel]].]]

While Rogue [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nrin Vakil]] infiltred the [[Imperial Citadel (Eiattu 6)|Imperial Citadel]] to rescue his fellows, the PLB attacked the capital with the remaining Rogues (Wedge, Plourr and [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]) in the air. They were victorious but Tavira managed to flee with a portion of the planet treasury. Upon ending that confrontation, Plourr faced off with "Harran," finally proving that he was an impostor.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Perhaps after that, with newfound unity, we can then learn to walk together.|[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Isplourrdacartha Estillo]]|<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess" />}}
After the battle, Plourr decided to remain on Eiattu to rule with Rial. The Rogues left Eiattu with one less pilot.

This battle was also a show of force designed to keep [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] [[Sander Delvardus|Delvardus]] and [[Utoxx Prentioch|Prentioch]] in their territories.<ref name="TEA" />
